summary: Configured persistent TCP rsyslog forwarding for node2 inventory messages to node1. Messages are stored at /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and forwarding recovered after each restart.
actions_performed: Configured node1 rsyslog TCP collector on port 514, filtered to inventory messages from node2.
Restricted node1 firewall access to node2 on TCP/514.
Configured node2 forwarding with a persistent disk-backed retry queue.
Verified unrelated application messages are excluded.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery.
Verified new inventory messages were persisted after each restart.

evidence.summary: Proves the live TCP path, inventory-only filtering, valid persistent configurations, and stored messages under /var/log/inventory/node2.log.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, disconnection, boot ID change, recovered collector/data, and successful post-restart forwarding.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, disconnection, boot ID change, recovered sender, re-established connection, and successful persistence on node1.
